verdict_basis: Combined finite native gate, 38 accepted UI prefix controls, automatic lifecycle tail, and assigned-process lifecycle smoke satisfy the scoped acceptance matrix. Original source artifacts retain their original results.

scope.input: Application-local virtual mice/keyboards only; no hardware, RustDesk, SendInput, or SetCursorPos input.
scope.targets: Disposable test-owned x64/x86 applications, explicitly scoped by PID.
scope.host_displays: One connected monitor with an OS monitor-interface identity; read-only inventory only.
scope.alignment: Actual overlay HWND origin plus shape hotspot equals logical cursor coordinates; native cursor API alignment is required inside authorized eligible client/Region scope. Full monitor/desktop extrema verify logical and overlay clamping without a broader native-hover claim.
scope.assigned_scope: Bounded ring-hotspot, per-user Region settings cleanup, paused clamp/Resume synchronization, profile save and Stop smoke; not exhaustive assigned-process message compatibility.

criteria_verified: Distinct nonempty native rendered bitmap hashes for Arrow, Crosshair, I-beam and Ring on both architectures; actual window geometry, click-through/no-activate styles and native hit-test/mouse-activate responses.
Cursor sizes 12 and 64, eight-character Unicode badge, label/badge rendering, hidden/shown status and native window visibility.

13 discoverable object-schema tools on this accepted build; full settings shape/bounds enums, defaults, and routing_displays inventory usable with an empty DLL-free runtime and no active routing session.
Legacy lock true/false, Desktop, Window, Monitor and monitor work-area absolute/relative logical clamp; Region immediate native clamp and overlay alignment in eligible target scope.

Live settings application releases selected-user held input while retaining the other user; malformed/empty/outside regions, missing/disconnected monitor identity and invalid badge reject before live settings, positions, holds or appearance mutate.

Pause releases held input and changes rendered palette. Bounds application during pause clamps logical overlay coordinates while native cursor remains unchanged; Resume restores exact native/overlay/hotspot alignment in automatic and assigned routers.
Actual Ouroboros shape choices, hide/show and bounds controls; saved profile preserves appearance/bounds fields and old profile defaults; Stop destroys overlays and releases input.

portable_signed_coordinate_evidence.review: Negative-origin monitor/region intersection is asserted with concrete signed rectangles in the passing core test. The host native inventory had no negative-origin monitor.

real_defect_found_and_fixed.defect: UpdateLayeredWindow used logical minus hotspot, but a subsequent SetWindowPos moved the overlay back to logical x/y. Centered cursor shapes therefore had incorrect actual HWND origins.
real_defect_found_and_fixed.fix: Final SetWindowPos uses the computed render position (pos.x/pos.y).
real_defect_found_and_fixed.independent_verification: Native001834 verifies actual GetWindowRect under a per-monitor-v2 runner DPI context, rather than accepting telemetry alone; UI controls and both lifecycle tails also verify actual origin plus hotspot.

runner_corrections: BoundsMode JSON Schema uses oneOf with enum/const; the runner now interprets those valid schema forms.
Hide/Show controls belong to the Overlay tab; the runner added that actual navigation action.
Removed the unpromised per-user paused status-string expectation; actual pause palette and native deferral/resume behavior remain required.

required_rust_checks.reported_by_parent: Final bundle92947 passed formatting, strict workspace Clippy, all29 workspace tests, and both x64/i686 builds. Acceptance did not repeat those completed checks.

artifacts.interpretation: 38 individual controls passed. The aggregate result remains NOT ACCEPTED; its failure came from an invalid runner expectation requiring the per-user route status string to contain paused.
artifacts.excluded_unpromised_criterion: State.status describes the user route, not the overall controller pause state. The pause requirement was verified in the subsequent tails through held-input release, rendered paused palette, native motion deferral during bounds apply, and exact native/overlay alignment after Resume.

cleanup.audit: Final exact-path CIM process audit found no acceptance control, probe or worker process. Exclusive live slot released.

unverified_and_not_claimed: Physical HID input or hardware compatibility.
Real display hot-unplug, monitor reconnect identity stability, multiple-monitor transitions or general mixed-DPI correctness.
Arbitrary third-party application compatibility or native OS cursor-theme replacement.
GPU cursor rendering, desktop-wide isolation or simultaneous independent users inside one process.
